summary: Create managed worktrees through one backend-owned recoverable saga with durable identity, idempotent retries, correlated progress, setup/startup receipts, and explicit recovery across every client.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android 0.5.7 after the on-device worktree creation and reconnect matrix

automated: Release-gate npm test: 312 files / 3,029 tests passed on the v0.8.43 integrated tree, including request validation, real Git materialization, idempotency, per-repository serialization, recovery, compensation, setup/startup receipts, owner linkage, remote authorization, Desktop coordination, mobile capability skew, compatibility leases, host/preload routing, and legacy backfill.
npm run typecheck passed for main and renderer; the final npm run build repeated all 312 files / 3,029 tests, built main/preload/renderer/server bundles, and passed the packaged-main smoke boot.

Electron backend-host E2E passed twice through the real preload, IPC, SQLite, and Git worktree transaction with 16 assertions per run: one ready sidebar-visible owner conversation, one canonical worktree, same-creation duplicate reuse, and durable GET reconciliation. Electron-native modules were rebuilt only in an isolated temporary runtime, and mandatory sb-* cleanup was verified after every pass and failure.
React Native/iOS: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json, all 17 Jest tests, and 50 focused shared mobile/capability/transport contract tests passed.

Native Android: :app:testDebugUnitTest and :app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin passed under OpenJDK 17, including Room process-death recovery, capability gating, retry/action semantics, and attachment-safe compatibility behavior.
hardware: Native Android production upgrade on CPH2487: the installed production-signed 0.5.5/versionCode 7 client discovered mobile-v0.5.6 through the existing in-app updater, downloaded the signed APK, invoked Android package replacement, and reopened as 0.5.6/versionCode 8. The package ceDataInode and original firstInstallTime were unchanged, the paired Mac and existing conversation/activity rows remained visible, and no Room migration or startup crash was observed.
notExercised: Desktop manual UI creation, explicit failure/recovery UX, app kill/restart, parent-checkout fallback, stable terminal-handle adoption, and post-operation git/database inspection have not yet been exercised by a human.
Creation through a separately running remote machine/backend has not yet been manually exercised.
React Native/iOS worktree creation has not been exercised on iOS hardware.

Native Android worktree creation, progress, reconnect, and recovery have not yet been exercised on Android hardware; the production upgrade and Room 4-to-5 startup succeeded, while instrumentation migrations were compiled but not run on-device.
No iOS simulator or Android instrumentation test was run; Android instrumentation sources were compiled only.
